algorithm_status: Research combination; not demonstrated on Gemma 4 and not yet trained.

cold_start.curriculum: Shared six-tool course for all four adapters; G additionally covers all mechanisms. Rank/target-incompatible G and expert checkpoints are independently trained.
cold_start.assistant_mask: Only adjudicated, execution-supported action spans are positive targets; errors may remain in conditioning history.

baseline.assignment: Collect with designated owner adapter; not a paired specialist-versus-G efficacy experiment. Any later matched-G comparison is additional compute.

admission.source_native: Raw candidates only; keep publisher outcomes and all identity anomalies.
admission.six_tool_cold_start: Actual official-tool actions/observations, valid task/environment join, full verifier evidence, actual tokenizer/template and loss spans.
admission.critical_action_pair: Same pre-action restored declared scope, identical prefix and remaining budget, one intervened action, same continuation policy, both terminal verifications completed.
admission.recovery_segment: Declared restore scope plus authentic multi-step execution; keep local progress separate from task resolution.
admission.on_policy: Behavior policy/adapter identity, actual per-token sampling logprobs and masks, seeds/decoding, correct episode/state group and rewards.

raw_signals.task_resolved_verified: true/false only after completed valid verification; otherwise null
raw_signals.local_signal: Typed evidence with execution/log references, never silently converted to resolved

budget_learning.priority: Verified task completion first; study cost among comparable successful outcomes or explicit constrained objectives.
budget_learning.agent_output_scope: Reasoning plus tool-call arguments plus other output, accumulated across turns; do not use characters as tokens.
budget_learning.baseline_budget: Estimate from separate valid training-task success runs, without choosing hindsight-minimal branches or evaluation answers.

isolation.public_competition_129: Development only in this plan; never ingested by collector
isolation.gold_and_privileged_verifier: Collector side only, absent from pre-action policy context
isolation.source_patch: Requires identity consistency audit; current Smith seed patch column quarantined

execution_authorization: CPU-side public-source preparation only. No GPU training, paid sampling or source-command execution performed by prepare_native.py.

current_inventory_refs.note: Plan targets below are not achieved rollout or pair counts.96 source/mechanism task records exist; successes are separately recorded human off-policy demonstrations.
